what: Publishes the public keys on /keys/: the registry agent that keeps the team's vault keys (handed over by the operator as a QR code) and this site's agent. Public halves only, each with a bundle file and how it came to be trusted.

Brings the repository up to the sgit.ai checklist for a new repository (docs/guidance/repositories): participant disclosure, BRIEF-CORRECTIONS.md and REALITY.md, a markdown twin for every page, and three more gate checks (twins and llms.txt, orphan pages, private sgit key shapes).

Redesign in the house style of sgit.ai, coding.sgit.ai and ux.sgit.ai: warm paper palette and teal accent as tokens with a dark theme, sticky nav with the parent-site pill, a home page written for a stranger and dated, cards, skip link and focus styles. validate now fails on a literal colour outside the tokens. Heading anchors written {#id} now render as anchors instead of literal text.

Adds the briefing for the inbox agent (what the team is doing, the rules for a reply, where the current facts live, how the agent and its operator use the vaults) and the inbox agent on the team roster.
Records that pki.sgit.ai keys are paused for now, and how an agent's key is trusted instead.
The gitignore check in validate now uses --no-index, so it catches ignored files that are already tracked. It did not fire in v0.1.2.

Fixes the release: .gitignore excluded every build/ directory, so CI had no validator. Adds the team roster (data/team.json) and the team pages, and the validate check that no source file is gitignored.
Not released: the first push. validate failed in CI because admin/build/ was gitignored; nothing was tagged or deployed.
